# Drum: the six gem cuts on one ring round the X axis, R 0.78 m out, 60 degrees apart: slot 0
# sapphire (round brilliant), 1 jade (square step cut), 2 amber (trillion), 3 garnet (marquise),
# 4 pearl, 5 the brilliant (an eight-point star, unlit). The drum's origin is its axis; baked once a
# board cell (pool `gem`), the game turns the cut it needs to the top and the other five stay under
# the velvet and the bench. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Sapphire --base-color 0.2275 0.4392 0.5569 --no-slot
material new Jade --base-color 0.3098 0.3647 0.2588 --no-slot
material new Amber --base-color 0.9098 0.6980 0.4353 --no-slot
material new Garnet --base-color 0.4392 0.3020 0.1686 --no-slot
material new Pearl --base-color 0.9294 0.9020 0.7961 --no-slot
material new Star --base-color 0.9608 0.8471 0.5765 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name G0a --vertices 8 --radius 0.215 --depth 0.04 --location 0 0 0.800
add mesh cone --name G0b --vertices 8 --radius1 0.215 --radius2 0.115 --depth 0.10 --location 0 0 0.870
select G0a G0b
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
select G0a G0b
material assign Sapphire
select G0a
active G0a
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.785 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select G0b
active G0b
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.785 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select G0a G0b
active G0a
join
rename G0a G0
select G0
active G0
set rotation 0 0 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cylinder --name G1a --vertices 4 --radius 0.27 --depth 0.05 --location 0 0 0.805
add mesh cone --name G1b --vertices 4 --radius1 0.27 --radius2 0.155 --depth 0.09 --location 0 0 0.875
select G1a G1b
set rotation 0 0 45
apply --rotation
select G1a G1b
material assign Jade
select G1a
active G1a
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.785 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select G1b
active G1b
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.785 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select G1a G1b
active G1a
join
rename G1a G1
select G1
active G1
set rotation 60 0 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cylinder --name G2a --vertices 3 --radius 0.27 --depth 0.04 --location 0 -0.03 0.800
add mesh cone --name G2b --vertices 3 --radius1 0.27 --radius2 0.12 --depth 0.11 --location 0 -0.03 0.875
select G2a G2b
set rotation 0 0 90
apply --rotation
select G2a G2b
material assign Amber
select G2a
active G2a
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.785 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select G2b
active G2b
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.785 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select G2a G2b
active G2a
join
rename G2a G2
select G2
active G2
set rotation 120 0 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cylinder --name G3a --vertices 6 --radius 0.25 --depth 0.04 --location 0 0 0.800
add mesh cone --name G3b --vertices 6 --radius1 0.25 --radius2 0.12 --depth 0.10 --location 0 0 0.870
select G3a G3b
set rotation 0 0 0
apply --rotation
select G3a G3b
scale 1 0.62 1
apply --scale
select G3a G3b
material assign Garnet
select G3a
active G3a
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.785 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select G3b
active G3b
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.785 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select G3a G3b
active G3a
join
rename G3a G3
select G3
active G3
set rotation 180 0 0
apply --rotation
add mesh uv-sphere --name G4a --segments 8 --rings 6 --radius 0.195 --location 0 0 0.800
select G4a
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
select G4a
material assign Pearl
select G4a
active G4a
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.785 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
rename G4a G4
select G4
active G4
set rotation 240 0 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cone --name G5a --vertices 4 --radius1 0.25 --radius2 0 --depth 0.17 --location 0 0 0.865
add mesh cone --name G5b --vertices 4 --radius1 0.17 --radius2 0 --depth 0.15 --location 0 0 0.855 --rotation 0 0 45
select G5b
apply --rotation
select G5a G5b
set rotation 0 0 0
apply --rotation
select G5a G5b
material assign Star
select G5a
active G5a
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.785 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select G5b
active G5b
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.785 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select G5a G5b
active G5a
join
rename G5a G5
select G5
active G5
set rotation 300 0 0
apply --rotation
select G0 G1 G2 G3 G4 G5
active G0
join
rename G0 Drum
shade flat
export drum.glb
